title: Denmark – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – KU MT14 Virologisk Center - Totalrådgivning
description: Bygningsstyrelsen udbyder en aftale om totalrådgivning vedrørende etablering af Virologisk Center i en eksisterende bygning til brug for Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet (SUND) ved Københavns Universitet (KU). Virologisk Center skal etableres som en laboratoriefacilitet til forskning i virus tilhørende risikogruppe 2 og 3 (BSL3) samt arbejde med genetisk modificerede virus klassificeret som GMO klasse 2 (GMO2). Laboratoriefaciliteten skal udføres som en indeslutningsfacilitet, der kan godkendes og klassificeres til BSL3- og GMO2-niveau. Faciliteten skal overholde krav i danske regelsæt og herudover skal relevante internationale manualer, standarder, guidelines samt best practice på området inddrages og lægges til grund – såvel metodemæssigt i form analyser, risiko- og kvalitetsstyring som i form af løsningsvalg, udførelse og verifikation heraf. Projektets specialiserede karakter forudsætter derfor stærke rådgivningskompetencer generelt - og herunder specialistkompetencer inden for biocontainment - med indgående erfaring fra tilsvarende byggerier samt kendskab til gældende danske og internationale krav til BSL3-laboratorier. Projektet omfatter et bruttoareal på ca. 520 m². Projektet forventes gennemført med tidlig inddragelse af en leverandør af barrieresystem, mens øvrige arbejder forventes udbudt i 1-2 storentrepriser med Bygningsstyrelsen som bygherre og Københavns Universitet som bruger. Anslået værdi for kontrakt: 35 mio. kr. Der er tale om et ikke-bindende skøn baseret på Bygningsstyrelsens nuværende budgetforudsætninger. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet. Udbudsbetingelserne indeholder en nærmere beskrivelse af opgaven og udbudsforløbet, og det øvrige materiale indeholder en beskrivelse af opgavens omfang

title: Germany – Contractor's all-risk insurance services – Projektversicherung für das Projekt Herstellung Zweigleisigkeit Strecke 6142, Abschnitt Lübbenau-Cottbus
description: Die DB InfraGO AG plant den 2-gleisigen Ausbau der Strecke Lübbenau-Cottbus. Projektinhalt der Gesamtmaßnahme ist der zweigleisige Ausbau der Strecke 6142 (Berlin – Görlitz) im Abschnitt Lübbenau (a) – Cottbus (a) von km 85,325 bis km 112,500, der bislang lediglich ein Gleis aufweist. Das Bauvorhaben wird in zwei antragsgegenständliche Planfeststellungsabschnitte gegliedert. Deren Grenze ist die Kreisgrenze zwischen den Landkreisen Oder-Spreewald-Lausitz und Spree-Neiße. Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit EUR 365 Mio. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 30 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 30.06.2028 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. (Typ M) In der Haftpflichtversicherung beträgt die Deckungssumme je Schadenfall EUR 25.000.000 pauschal für Personen-, Sach- und Vermögensschäden, einschließlich der Leistungen aus der Umwelthaftpflichtversicherung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extendend Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelthaftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. Für Personenschäden entfällt der Selbstbehalt. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung ist die erweiterte Planungsdeckung eingeschlossen. Im Rahmen der erweiterten Planungsdeckung beträgt der Selbstbehalt EUR 100.000.

title: Belgium – Construction work for steel bridges – Vernieuwen balans Noordkasteelbrug Oost
description: Doel is het volledig vernieuwen van de balansconstructie van de Oostelijke Noordkasteelbrug. Het vernieuwen van de balans van de Noordkasteelbrug is een ingreep om de initieel vooropgestelde levensduur te kunnen blijven garanderen. In grootte-orde bevat de scope van de werken aan de oostelijke brug: ­ Vernieuwen balansarm incl. windverbanden ­ Vernieuwen verbindingen balans en kist en mogelijk vernieuwen kist (+ vulling) ­ Vernieuwen trekstangen ­ Revisie en eventuele beperkte herstellingen (oa schokdempers) aan heugelbalken ­ Nauwkeurig inmeten van A, B, C en D scharnieren ­ Gedetailleerde weging van de vlucht ten einde de uitgangspunten bij ontwerp te kunnen verifiëren ­ Vervangen hoofddraaipunten Oostbrug (A+B+C+D lagers) cfr huidige configuratie ­ Optimaliseren alle lagers Oostbrug ­ Herstellen verankeringen A-scharnieren ­ Voorzien van secundair staal (leuningen, ladders, bordessen) zoals opgenomen in bestek ­ alle nodige demontage en montagewerken Met als randvoorwaarde de bestaande vluchten, stoel, heugelbalken, aandrijving en elektrische installaties te behouden. Naast de renovatiewerken aan de oostbrug dienen er wel enkele veiligheidsmaatregelen aan de westbrug te gebeuren; Deze omvatten beperkte aanpassingswerken aan secundair staal (leuningen, ladders, bordessen). Bijkomend kan de opdrachtnemer eventueel aangesteld worden voor het uitvoeren van dringende herstellingen aan de westbrug bij calamiteiten/storingen, dit gedurende de werken aan de oostbrug, teneinde onderbrekingen en stremmingen voor alle verkeersmodi tot een minimum te beperken.

buyer: INSPECTORATUL PENTRU SITUATII DE URGENTA "A.D.GHICA" TELEORMAN
title: Romania – Repair and maintenance services of cranes – Acord-cadru de prestare servicii de întreținere și reparații instalații speciale ce se află montate pe autospecialele de intervenție și salvare de la înălțimi pentru o perioadă de 12 de luni
description: Autoritatea contractantă va încheia acorduri-cadru de prestare a serviciilor de întreținere și reparații instalații speciale ce se află montate pe autospecialele de intervenție și salvare de la înălțimi din parcul auto al I.S.U. Teleorman pentru o perioadă de 12 de luni, împărțind în acest sens achiziția în 2 loturi, astfel încât să corespundă mai bine necesităților autorității contractante, precum și capacității operatorilor economici. Autoritatea contractantă este interesată să achiziționeze atât piesele de schimb și materialele necesare pentru procesul de reparare și întreținere a instalațiilor speciale, cât și serviciile menționate, acestea efectuându-se în atelierele specializate ale operatorilor economici câștigători. În derularea acordurilor-cadru se va avea în vedere faptul că orice serviciu de mentenanță preventivă și/sau corectivă va fi achiziționat doar în baza unui contract subsecvent, semnat de către reprezentanții legali ai părților, în limita fondurilor bugetare alocate. Ofertanții pot depune oferta de preț pentru unul sau mai multe loturi, detaliat pe fiecare tip/marcă de instalație specială solicitat de către autoritatea contractantă, conform specificațiilor caietului de sarcini. Operatorii economici trebuie să facă dovada că dețin cel puțin un atelier specializat sau că au încheiate acorduri de asociere sau subcontractare cu operatori economici autorizați să execute servicii ce fac obiectul contractului. În situații în care, după atribuirea contractului, fondurile alocate sunt sub pragurile estimate, autoritatea contractantă nu-și asumă obligația de a executa reparațiile curente și reviziile tehnice la valoarea maximă prezentată în fișa de date. Acordul-cadru, ca modalitate specială de atribuire a unui contract de achiziție publică, conține cantități estimate de produse și servicii pe care autoritatea contractantă consideră că le va achiziționa ulterior, cantități care apar la nivelul documentației de atribuire a respectivului acord-cadru, autoritatea contractantă având obligația, ulterior, la momentul încheierii contractelor subsecvente, de a stabili cantitățile fixe ce vor fi achiziționate în baza respectivului contract subsecvent. Serviciile și produsele de mentenanță preventivă și corectivă ce se vor achiziționa trebuie să îndeplinească în totalitate cerințele minime ale specificațiilor tehnice așa cum sunt prevăzute în caietul de sarcini. Cantitățile minime și maxime ale acordului-cadru, respectiv ale contractelor subsecvente, sunt menționate în caietul de sarcini.

description: 1. title: Finland – Adult and other education services – Kohti työtä ja ammattia -kotoutumiskoulutus
description: Tampereen kaupunki pyytää tarjouksia tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Kilpailutuksella hankitaan työvoimapalveluiden järjestämisestä annetun lain (380/2023) ja kotoutumisen edistämisestä annetun lain (681/2023) mukaista kotoutumiskoulutusta. Avoimella menettelyllä valitaan yksi palveluntuottaja, jonka kanssa tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa oleva hankintasopimus. Hankittavan palvelun sisältö on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevassa palvelukuvauksessa. Tarjouspyynnön liitteet löytyvät kohdasta Tarjouspyynnön liitteet. Hankittavan palvelun ennakoitu arvo ylittää julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (hankintalaki 1397/2016) 25 §:n mukaisen kynnysarvon liitteen E hankinnoille, joten kilpailutuksessa sovelletaan hankintalakia. Hankintayksikkö valitsee tarjouksista kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisimman. Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä.

buyer: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
title: Cybersicherheit von Betriebssystemen in software-definierten Fahrzeugen (SecAutomotiveOS)
description: Ziel des Projektes ist es, einen Gesamtüberblick über die im Fahrzeug eingesetzten eingebetteten Betriebssysteme (einschließlich Virtualisierungsumgebungen) und eine Bewertung der Cybersicherheitseigenschaften zu erhalten. Es sollen dabei die Einsatzbedingungen (Hardwareplattformen, Zugriffsmöglichkeiten auf Steuereinheiten usw.) und das Zusammenspiel der Betriebssysteme im Rahmen der Gesamtfahrzeugarchitektur einbezogen werden. Neben der Betrachtung der aktuell auf dem Markt befindlichen Systeme und einschlägiger Standards soll auch ein Ausblick auf die zukünftigen Entwicklungen gegeben werden. Anforderungen an Fahrzeug-Betriebssysteme aus Cybersicherheitssicht sollen aus den gültigen Regulierungen und Standards abgeleitet werden. Dies schließt Anforderungen an Prüfungen im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung und Marktüberwachung ein. Neben einer Quellenrecherche für den Marktüberblick sollen auch praktische Analysen an verschiedenen Betriebssystemen durchgeführt werden. Diese sollen im Rahmen des Arbeitspakets 5 (AP 5) durchgeführt werden. Der zu erstellende Prüfkatalog soll hier praktisch verifiziert werden können. Ergebnis des Projekts ist eine Studie, die die oben genannten Inhalte umfasst.

buyer: Bundesamt für Sicherheit in der Informationstechnik
title: Projekt 1023: Prüfkriterien für Reinforcement Learning (RL-Criteria)
description: Das Projekt erarbeitet einen Katalog von Anforderungen, die der Bewertung der Sicherheit und Vertrauenswürdigkeit von Reinforcement Learning nutzenden KI-Anwendungen dienen. Die Anforderungen haben das Ziel, ein möglichst breites Spektrum an Anwendungen abzudecken. Dabei werden grundsätzlich alle Techniken und Ausprägungen von Reinforcement Learning, insbesondere auch im Zusammenhang mit großen und aktuellen generativen Modellen (Stichworte: RLHF, RLAIF), berücksichtigt. Die Anforderungen werden in der konkreten Ausarbeitung jeweils durch Erklärungen, begleitende Informationen, Umsetzungshinweise (z.B. Erläuterungen zum Einsatz geeigneter Testmethoden) u.ä. ergänzt. Der Katalog bildet damit eine Grundlage zur Selbsteinschätzung und zur Prüfung entsprechender KI-Systeme. Die im Projekt erstellten Anforderungen werden so aufbereitet, dass sie kompatibel zur SdT -Bibliothek des BSI sind und sich in das bestehende Produktportfolio des BSI zu KI-spezifischen Prüfkriterien einfügen. Konkret sind die Anforderungen abschließend als ergänzendes Modul zum BSI A5 zu gestalten.

title: Marketing Media Agency Services
description: VIA is seeking a results-driven marketing media agency to help fulfill its vision of being a smarter way to move people and its passenger-first mission. The objective of this mandate is to establish a strategic partnership with a media agency capable of delivering innovative, data-driven, and integrated media solutions that will strengthen VIA’s brand affinity, deepen customer engagement, and contribute to passenger growth objectives. The selected Service Provider must possess demonstrated expertise in media strategy, planning, buying, optimization, performance measurement, and audience targeting across traditional and digital channels, while leveraging industry best practices, emerging technologies, and data-driven insights to maximize the effectiveness of VIA's media investments. Mandatory Requirement Details: 1) Supplier Eligibility: Tenderer must be a Canadian Supplier or Supplier of an Applicable Trading Partner. 2) Official Languages: As a Crown corporation, VIA provides services in both official languages in all regions of Canada. Tenderer must be able to provide and deliver all the services specified in Part B, Appendix A to VIA in both Canada’s official languages (oral and in written, including all communications, presentations, reports and other documents) to ensure the respect of the Official Languages Act of Canada. 3) Location: The Tenderer has a place of business in Canada. 4) Experience: The Tenderer must have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience in the media agency industry.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. title: Purchase of one (1) General-Purpose Laboratory Vacuum Vessel
description: NRC’s Herzberg Astronomy and Astrophysics Research Center performs cryogenic research to support its astronomical instrumentation program. To support the development of cryogenic instrumentation, it is beneficial to test mechanisms at cryogenic temperatures to verify their performance and lifetime. To enable this testing, NRC is building a test cryostat to allow custom and commercial cryogenic mechanisms to be tested thoroughly prior to use in an instrument. This vacuum vessel will be integrated with a cryocooler, vacuum pump, and other custom parts to create this new cryogenic testing capability.

title: Pacific Science Enterprise Centre (PSEC) Shotcrete Pile Cap Thickening Project, West Vancouver, BC
description: The PSEC located at 4160 Marine Drive, West Vancouver, BC, requires pile cap restoration. The scope of work includes the supply of materials, equipment, tools, services, labour, and all things necessary for the completion of shotcrete concrete reinforcing on the pile caps at the PSEC site. The pile caps under the wharf at PSEC need to be thickened for repair purposes. This requirement aims to thicken the pile caps under the wharf at PSEC. Work to be performed under this Contract includes, but not limited to, the following items covered further in the Contract Documents: 1. Review site specific information. 2. Mobilization and demobilization, including: a) All crew, tools, equipment, means of access, and materials. b) Site clean-up after completion of work 3. Approximately 82.5 linear metres of pile caps that require shotcrete; details are outlined in tender drawings. Familiarization with site Before submitting a bid, bidders can visit the site and its surroundings, at their own expense, to review and verify the form, nature, and extent of the work, materials needed for the completion of the work, the means of access to the site, severity, exposure, and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies, and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account or error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. All work including clean-up and demobilization must be completed by February 28, 2027.

Step 2: Read the Call for Proposals : https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities/tender-notice/cb-331-17030872 Step 3: Propose your solution here : https://ised-isde.canada.ca/site/innovative-solutions-canada/en/minerva-initiative-uncrewed-air-system-cargomunition-drop?auHash=aUYSwVfmHbX1C0Ib4yBClo29RgX8gchivNFIqzsBK8s Challenge title: MINERVA Initiative – Uncrewed Air System for Cargo/Munition Drop Challenge sponsor: Department of National Defense (DND) The Department of National Defence (DND) and the Canadian Army (CA) requires an uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) for the aerial delivery of cargo and munitions that is domestically produced, easy to operate and maintain, and adequately rugged to enable the Canadian soldier to successfully fight and survive on the future battlefield. Challenge sponsor: Department of National Defense (DND) Funding mechanism: Contract Opening date: August 24, 2026 Closing date: October 5, 2026, 14:00 Eastern time Challenge Problem statement The CA soldier will face an increasingly complex and dangerous battlespace in the future. A major element of the complexity and danger is the proliferation of multi-spectral sensors and precision weapons that will limit the CA’s ability to move cargo and strike enemy targets at range by using attributable ballistic trajectory weapons without the risk of being targeted and attacked. The CA presently lacks an UAS capable of conducting short-range cargo delivery of light supplies or remote munitions drops. The CA requires an innovative uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) that provides an uncrewed alternative to move combat supplies forward towards the frontline and to deliver munitions independent of predictable ballistic trajectories and launch signatures. This innovation must be simple, durable, and highly survivable, providing soldiers with an effective capability for future conflicts that integrates seamlessly into operations while minimizing training and maintenance requirements, allowing soldiers to focus on their mission. Desired outcomes and considerations Essential (mandatory) outcomes The proposed solution would: 1. Be composed of an: a. Air vehicle: The airframe containing the onboard electronics, propulsion, and payload. b. Sensor payload: The equipment required for navigation and to complete a mission, such as cameras or imaging systems. c. Ground control station (GCS): The system (laptop, tablet, or handheld controller) used by the human operator to control flight and manage missions. d. Radio: The wireless system that connects the GCS to the UAS to transmit commands and receive telemetry/data. e. Battery with charger: A battery for the UAS and a battery charger capable of charging multiple batteries simultaneously. f. Remote antenna: An external antenna placed 100m away from the GCS to enhance signal strength, reduce interference, and extend operational range. 2. Operate in various weather conditions, including at a minimum: a. temperature range of -20°C and +40°C; b. minimum windspeed of up to 40 km/hr; and c. light rain or snow ranging 0.5mm/m²/hr. 3. Be able to carry a minimum payload of 5kg of cargo. 4. Have a maximum takeoff weight than 25kg (includes payload). 5. Have both a minimum operational radius of 10km and an endurance of 30 min in continuous movement while carrying its payload. 6. Have vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) capability in a maximum area of 2m². 7. Be stowable in a 70-litre pack. 8. Be capable of operating at a minimum operational altitude of 1000 feet Above Ground Level (AGL). Additional outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Be deployable from a stowed state to a mission-ready state in 10 minutes or less. This includes the completion of all pre-mission preparation activities, including but not limited to unloading vehicle, loading/fueling the power system and loading/configuring mission set resulting in a vehicle that is fully mission-ready at the line of departure. 2. Have a sensor that enables the operator to recognize a target at a minimum distance under the following conditions: a. Day – Person (180cm) at 0.5km, Vehicle (5m x 3m x 2m) at 1km b. Night – Person (180cm) at 0.25km, Vehicle (5m x 3m x 2m) at 0.5km 3. Emit no more than 5 decibels Sound Pressure Level (dB SPL) of noise in all frequency ranges, measured at a 500m distance from the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). 4. Be capable of operating with fibre-optic wire, or an alternate non-Electromagnetic (EM) spectrum means. 5. Incorporate Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) 256k encryption or equivalent for data transmission security. 6. Return to a pre-determined location, hover/loiter and/or climb in case of loss of link. 7. Have an aggregated projected production cost of $40,000 CAD or less per system. 8. Have a Ground Control Station (GCS) that: a. Incorporates a training simulation capability for Mission Planning. b. Has a minimum remote antenna cable length of 50m. c. Enables UAS navigation via both direct operator control and autonomously using waypoint navigation via the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS). d. Displays the following information: - Location of vehicle in 6 figure Military Grid Reference System (MGRS); - Orientation of vehicle (pitch/roll/yaw); - Point of aim of camera in 6 figure MGRS; - Real-time full motion video feed; - Altitude in Metres above Sea Level (MSL); and - Battery life. e. Is capable of interfacing with the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK) battle management system to push UAS Position Location Information (PLI) and target PLI. 9. Have an alternate non-electric or hybrid power system capable of sustained operation beyond battery power (i.e. a gas-powered system or a gas/electric hybrid power system). 10. Demonstrate capacity in having its critical components produced and sourced in countries within the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) alliance, NATO Partners or Major Non-NATO Allies . To achieve this, Offerors are requested to provide as an attachment to their proposal, a list identifying the solution's critical components, the country of production and sourcing for each component. title: France – Financial consultancy services – Accord-Cadre pour du conseil fiscal expatriés et réalisation de bilans retraite
description: L'objet du marché porte sur 2 lots distincts : LOT 1 : La Direction Dirigeants, Talents et Mobilité (DDTM) du Groupe EDF exprime un besoin pour une prestation d'accompagnement fiscal, destinée à ses dirigeants expatriés. Cette prestation doit couvrir l'ensemble du cycle de l'expatriation : Avant le départ : Conseils préparatoires, analyse de l'éligibilité à des régimes spécifiques comme le régime des impatriés. Pendant l'expatriation : Établissement des déclarations de revenus annuelles, assistance en cas de contrôle fiscal, conseils sur les conventions fiscales internationales, gestion des prélèvements à la source. Après le retour : Accompagnement pour la clôture des dossiers fiscaux et les déclarations de retour. Le service attendu inclut des entretiens personnalisés, la réalisation des déclarations fiscales françaises au départ et au retour, des simulations fiscales, la rédaction de courriers administratifs. La prestation s'adresse à environ 40 dirigeants par an, majoritairement issus d'EDF SA, mais pouvant inclure des dirigeants expatriés en provenance d’autres entités du Groupe. L'enjeu est de sécuriser leur situation fiscale, de minimiser les risques et de garantir une transition fluide et sereine pour ces collaborateurs stratégiques. La flexibilité et la réactivité du prestataire sont essentielles pour s'adapter aux spécificités de chaque situation individuelle et aux évolutions législatives. LOT 2 : La Direction Dirigeants, Talents et Mobilité (DDTM) du Groupe EDF recherche un prestataire pour la réalisation de bilans retraite individualisés à destination de ses dirigeants. Ce besoin s'inscrit dans une démarche d'accompagnement et de sécurisation de la fin de carrière de ses collaborateurs clés, en leur fournissant une visibilité claire et des conseils personnalisés sur leur future retraite. Environ 250 dirigeants sont éligibles à cette prestation (estimation d’environ 40 à 50 bilans retraite / an), d'EDF SA et d’ENEDIS. Elle doit inclure plusieurs volets essentiels : Analyse exhaustive des droits : Recensement et vérification des droits acquis dans tous les régimes (base, complémentaire, surcomplémentaire, épargne salariale, etc.), y compris les spécificités du régime des IEG. Projections financières : Calculs détaillés des montants de pensions à différentes dates de départ à la retraite, avec des scénarios personnalisés. Plan d'action individualisé : Conseils sur les meilleures stratégies pour optimiser les droits, rachat de trimestres, impact des dispositifs de fin de carrière (temps partiel senior, etc.). Accompagnement administratif : Aide à la constitution des dossiers de liquidation. Information collective : Organisation de webinaires thématiques pour sensibiliser les dirigeants aux enjeux de la retraite. Le prestataire devra également assurer un reporting régulier et détaillé à EDF, permettant un suivi précis de l'avancement des bilans et des retours des dirigeants.

description: INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE The Department of Veterans Affairs Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6, on behalf of the Durham VA Medical Center intends to enter into a sole source procurement with Phillips Healthcare a division of Philips North America LLC, 414 Union Street, Philips Plaza 6th Floor, Nashville, TN 37219. NAICS code 339112-Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing. The proposed contract action is to provide a service agreement for the Xper IM Flex Cardio R2.x system at the Durham VAMC. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of RFO FAR 6.103-1 using the procedures under RFO FAR 13.106-1 (b), Soliciting from a single source. Contract will be for a period of performance of 01 Dec. 2026 through 30 Nov. 2027. This notice of intent is not a request for quotation. Interested parties may identify their interest in the requirement and capabilities to monique.cordero@va.gov no later than 10:00 AM EST, Oct. 5, 2026. Telephone inquirers will not be accepted. All information shall be furnished at no cost or obligation to the Government. Gray market items are Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) goods sold through unauthorized channels in direct competition with authorized distributors. This procurement is for a service agreement for the Xper IM Flex Cardio R2.x system that covers hardware and software. No remanufacture or gray market items will be acceptable. Vendor shall be an OEM, authorized dealer, authorized distributor or authorized reseller for the proposed medical supplies, medical equipment and/or services contracts for maintenance of medical equipment (i.e., replacement parts), verified by an authorization letter or other documents from the OEM, such that the OEM s warranty and service are provided and maintained by the OEM. All software licensing, warranty and service associated with the medical supplies, medical equipment and/or services contracts for maintenance of medical equipment shall be in accordance with the OEM terms and conditions. The delivery of gray market items to the VA in the fulfillment of an order/award constitutes a breach of contract. Accordingly, the VA reserves the right to enforce any of its contractual remedies. This includes termination of contract or, solely at the VA s election, allowing the Vendor to replace, at no cost to the Government, any remanufactured or gray market item(s) delivered to the VA medical facility upon discovery of such items. No solicitation will be made. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the Government not to complete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government.

title: Organist Services at James Lovell FHCC
description: This is not a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, bids, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to obtain information regarding the availability and capability of all qualified sources to perform a potential requirement. Responses to the information requested will assist the Government in determining the appropriate acquisition method. The Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) is soliciting businesses for Organist Services for Catholic and Protestant Religious Ceremonies (Mass) to the beneficiaries of the Captain James A. Lovell Federal Health Care Center located in North Chicago, IL. The contractor shall provide religious music, using either piano or organ, during Protestant/Catholic services on all Sundays and when requested on special holidays. The contractor shall provide this service for Veterans and their families attending Protestant/Catholic worship services. It is understood that all firms submitting a response to this Sources Sought shall be established businesses, and a minimum of 360 hours of music experience in a traditional church setting while performing these types of services. The Contractor shall provide an experienced Organist that can read sheet music, and who can play diverse Protestant and Catholic Hymns during church services. The work schedule hours of service are not to exceed 6 sessions per month. A session is defined as (1) one hour in duration. The specific work schedule will be determined by the Chaplain. Due to the nature of the setting, delays in performance of work may be experienced. Such delays may include but are not limited to inclement weather, electrical or mechanical problems, or other unforeseen matters. When contract employees report to the facility but are unable to perform services due to such delays, the contractor will be paid for one (1) session. Normally, any remaining sessions for that day will be suspended and the contractor will be free to leave and the contractor will not be paid for remaining unperformed sessions. However, if the facility requests that the contractor remain at the facility for eventual performance, the contractor shall be paid for such sessions. The following NAICS Code and Small Business Size Standard has been identified for this requirement: 813110 � Religious Organizations with a Small Business Size Standard of $13 Million in annual revenue. Interested firms shall provide an overview of their firm�s capabilities and experience with projects similar in size and scope of this project listed above. (All information shall be submitted in Word or PDF format, not to exceed 25 pages, including all attachments.) Firms shall identify whether they are a small business or other than small business in accordance with the size standard for NAICS code 813110. If another NAICS code may be applicable, please identify the NAICS in your capability statement along with your corresponding business size and socio-economic status. All information must be received no later than Monday, October 5th, 2026 at 10:00am (Central Time). Email information to Justin Lemke, Contract Specialist, at Justin.Lemke@va.gov. The Government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to provide services consistent in scope and scale with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or returned. BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR A SPECIFIC SMALL BUSINESS SOCIOECONOMIC CONTRACTING PROGRAM, SMALL BUSINESSES, OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. description: To facilitate market research, the Government is looking to identify qualified sources under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 541519 Other Computer Related Services. This Notice seeks industry comments to assist the Government. If you have any comments or find any ambiguities, please provide your information and comment in your response to this notice. Responses are requested from ALL sources including Other than Small Businesses. Small Businesses, 8(a) small businesses, HUBZone small businesses, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses, Women-Owned Small Businesses and Economically Disadvantaged Women-owned Small Businesses are encouraged to respond. This Sources Sought (SS) Notice is for information and planning purposes only and shall NOT be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Government. This notice does not obligate the Government to award a contract or otherwise pay for the information provided in the response. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate. Any concern responding to this notice should ensure that its response is complete and sufficiently detailed to allow the Government to determine the concern�s qualifications to perform the work. Respondents are advised that the Government is under no obligation to acknowledge receipt of the information received or provide feedback to respondents with respect to any information submitted. After a review of the responses received, a pre- solicitation synopsis and solicitation MAY be published in GSA Advantage at https://gsaadvantage.gov/. However, responses to this notice will not be considered adequate responses to a solicitation. The Government will NOT accept requests for meetings or briefings. No phone solicitations or email with regards to the status of the Request for Quote (RFQ) will be accepted prior to its release. Information and materials submitted in response to this notice WILL NOT be returned. As a result of this notice, the Government MAY issue a Request for Quote (RFQ). There is no solicitation available at this time. However, should such a requirement materialize, no basis for claims against the Government will arise as a result of a response to this Sources Sought Notice, nor the Government�s use of such information as either part of our evaluation process, nor in developing specifications for any subsequent requirement. 3.0 Background Walter Reed National Military Medical Center (WRNMMC) Department of Pathology operates a high-volume inpatient and outpatient clinical, anatomical, and pathological laboratory serving military beneficiaries and their families. The laboratory processes thousands of diagnostic tests daily across multiple disciplines including hematology, coagulation, chemistry, immunology, and blood banking. These critical laboratory services directly support patient diagnosis, treatment decisions, and ongoing care for service members, retirees, and their dependents. WRNMMC clinical laboratory requires a secure, reliable middleware solution to integrate multiple laboratory analyzers with the Military Health System Genesis (MHS Genesis) Laboratory Information System (LIS). These analyzers include hematology instruments, coagulation analyzers, chemistry platforms, immunoassay systems, and blood bank equipment located at the WRNMMC Clinical Laboratory in Bethesda, Maryland. The laboratory is required to maintain continuous operations 24 hours per day, 7 days per week to support emergency, inpatient, and outpatient testing needs. Additionally, the laboratory must maintain compliance with Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) regulations, College of American Pathologists (CAP) accreditation standards, and Department of Defense quality management requirements, which mandate ongoing test proficiency, method validation, quality control monitoring, and data integrity verification. Without an effective middleware solution, the laboratory faces significant operational challenges including manual data entry errors that compromise patient safety, workflow inefficiencies that delay critical test results, inability to perform automated result validation and quality control monitoring, and potential regulatory compliance failures. The middleware serves as the essential integration layer enabling bidirectional communication between laboratory instruments and the LIS, supporting automated order downloading, result transmission, quality control management, and comprehensive data analytics. This capability is critical to maintaining the laboratory's mission of providing accurate, timely diagnostic testing that supports clinical decision-making and ensures optimal patient outcomes for the military healthcare community served by WRNMMC. 4.0 Coordination Requirement: 4.1.1. The Contractor shall provide all Data Innovations Instrument Manager� and EP Evaluator� licenses and connectivity drivers, installation and configuration on government-furnished infrastructure, integration with existing LIS and analyzers, validation of data workflows, user training, and ongoing technical support and maintenance. 4.2. Shipping 4.2.1. The contractor shall ship directly as directed by the authorized Government ordering officer or ordering document. 4.3. Contract Deliverables 4.3.1. Within 10 working days after contract award, the Contractor shall coordinate and conduct a post-award site visit for the purpose of coordinating schedule for equipment installation. Additionally, the installation of equipment will need to be performed in a phased process. 4.3.2. The contractor shall deliver all products and services, as applicable, unless specified otherwise. 4.3.3. Contractor shall invoice in accordance with the terms and conditions of the contract. 5.0 Instructions: If your company has the capability to provide Data Innovations Instrument Manager� and EP Evaluator� software, licenses and connectivity drivers, installation and configuration on government-furnished infrastructure, integration with existing LIS and analyzers, validation of data workflows, user training, and ongoing technical support and maintenance, please send a Capability Statement and any additional Information detailed in section VI. General Information to the following email addresses. Phillip York: Carlos Sikaffy: Phillip.w.york2.civ@health.mil Chavock Warren: chavock.d.warren.civ@health.mil No phone calls related to this SSN will be accepted. All correspondence shall be via email. Responses must be submitted no later than Monday, October 4, 2026, at 10:00 AM (Eastern Standard Time). Capability statements will be retained for future reference. 6.0 General Information: To facilitate a timely and comprehensive review of all submitted responses, firms should respond using the format requested in this Notice. title: 6525--MRI TRAILER RELOCATION & SET UP
description: This Special Notice of Intent (NOI) is not a request for competitive proposals.� This is not a solicitation or request for offers. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), San Diego Healthcare System, intends to award a contract to Government Imaging Services LLC previously known as Salvadorini Consulting LLC for relocation of Mobile MRI Trailer. The MRI Trailer will be transported from Oceanside Community Base Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) to Jennifer Moreno Medical Center and then return to Oceanside CBOC. The unusual circumstances leading to justification for other than full and open competition is to support continuity of imaging services during the planned replacement of Jennifer Moreno Medical Center s 3T MRI Scanner. Government Imaging Services LLC is a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned business (SDVOSB) listed in the Small Business Administration (SBA) certification database found eligible and capable to meet the Governments requirements. The Mobile MRI Trailer is currently under contract with Government Imaging Services LLC. The owner possesses proprietary knowledge of the trailer s structural, electrical, and shielding specifications. Use of a different provider opens the Government to unacceptable risk of equipment damage and operational failure. The anticipated statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is in accordance with (IAW) The Department of Veterans Affair Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) 819.7008 Sole source award to a certified SDVOSB. Contracting Officers may use the non-competitive (sole source) procedures authorized in VAAR 819.7008 (DEVIATION). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this requirement is 621512. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6525.
